title: Elimination of Players
statementMd:
In a certain game, there are 𝑛n players numbered from 11 to 𝑛n. Each player has a strength — an integer from 11 to 𝑛n. All players have distinct strengths. The distribution of strengths is given by a permutation (𝑠1,𝑠2,…,𝑠𝑛)(s1,s2,…,sn), where 𝑠𝑗sj is the strength of player 𝑗j.

Initially, all players take part in the game. The game consists of 𝑛−1n−1 rounds. In the 𝑖i-th round, the player 𝑎𝑖ai is *protected*. It is possible that the protected player was already eliminated.

In each round, exactly one player is eliminated. This player is chosen as follows:

- if the player with the minimum strength among the remaining players is not protected, that player is eliminated;
- otherwise, the player with the second minimum strength among the remaining players is eliminated.

An eliminated player no longer takes part in the game. After the last round, exactly one player remains.

You are given the sequence 𝑎1,𝑎2,…,𝑎𝑛−1a1,a2,…,an−1, but the distribution of strengths is unknown. For each player 𝑗j and each round 𝑖i, find the number of permutations (𝑠1,𝑠2,…,𝑠𝑛)(s1,s2,…,sn) for which the player 𝑗j is eliminated in the 𝑖i-th round.

## Input

The first line contains one integer 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤25001≤t≤2500) — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of two lines:

- the first line contains one integer 𝑛n (2≤𝑛≤50002≤n≤5000) — the number of players;
- the second line contains 𝑛−1n−1 integers 𝑎1,𝑎2,…,𝑎𝑛−1a1,a2,…,an−1 (1≤𝑎𝑖≤𝑛1≤ai≤n) — the numbers of the protected players in the corresponding rounds. The values 𝑎𝑖ai may repeat.

Additional constraints on the input:

- the sum of 𝑛n over all test cases does not exceed 50005000.

## Output

For each test case, print the answer in the following way:

Let 𝑎𝑛𝑠(𝑖,𝑗)ans(i,j) denote the number of permutations (𝑠1,𝑠2,…,𝑠𝑛)(s1,s2,…,sn) for which player 𝑖i is eliminated in round 𝑗j, taken modulo 998244353998244353. Print one integer equal to ⊕𝑛𝑖=1⊕𝑛−1𝑗=1(𝑎𝑛𝑠(𝑖,𝑗)⋅𝑖⋅𝑗)⊕i=1n⊕j=1n−1(ans(i,j)⋅i⋅j), where ⊕⊕ denotes the bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) operation. Only the values 𝑎𝑛𝑠(𝑖,𝑗)ans(i,j) are taken modulo 998244353998244353; the products 𝑎𝑛𝑠(𝑖,𝑗)⋅𝑖⋅𝑗ans(i,j)⋅i⋅j and the final answer are not.

## Note

In the first test case, there are two possible distributions of strengths: (1,2)(1,2) and (2,1)(2,1). In the only round, player 22 is protected, so in both cases player 11 is eliminated. Thus, 𝑎𝑛𝑠(1,1)=2ans(1,1)=2, 𝑎𝑛𝑠(2,1)=0ans(2,1)=0, and the answer is

(2⋅1⋅1)⊕(0⋅2⋅1)=2.(2⋅1⋅1)⊕(0⋅2⋅1)=2.

In the second test case, there are 66 possible distributions of strengths. The values of 𝑎𝑛𝑠(𝑖,𝑗)ans(i,j) are shown in the table: rows correspond to players, columns — to rounds.

𝑖=1𝑖=2𝑖=3𝑗=1033𝑗=2501j=1j=2i=105i=230i=331

Player 11 is protected in the first round, and player 22 — in the second, so the corresponding values are zero. In the second round, player 11 is eliminated for five strength distributions, and player 33 — only for the distribution (3,1,2)(3,1,2). After multiplying the table values by the player and round numbers, we get the answer

0⊕10⊕6⊕0⊕9⊕6=3.0⊕10⊕6⊕0⊕9⊕6=3.

In the third test case, there are 2424 possible distributions of strengths. Player 11 is protected in all rounds and is never eliminated. The other three players are symmetric, so each of them is eliminated in each round for 24/3=824/3=8 strength distributions. The table of values 𝑎𝑛𝑠(𝑖,𝑗)ans(i,j) is

𝑖=1𝑖=2𝑖=3𝑖=4𝑗=10888𝑗=20888𝑗=30888j=1j=2j=3i=1000i=2888i=3888i=4888

The products for player 11 are zero. The XOR of the products for the remaining players gives the answer

16⊕32⊕48⊕24⊕48⊕72⊕32⊕64⊕96=96.16⊕32⊕48⊕24⊕48⊕72⊕32⊕64⊕96=96.
statementZhMd:
某个游戏中共有 $n$ 名选手，编号从 $1$ 到 $n$。每位选手有一个实力值——一个介于 $1$ 到 $n$ 之间的整数。所有选手的实力值互不相同。实力分布由一个排列 $(s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n)$ 给出，其中 $s_j$ 为选手 $j$ 的实力值。

初始时，所有选手都参加游戏。游戏共进行 $n-1$ 轮。在第 $i$ 轮中，选手 $a_i$ 会*受到保护*。受保护的选手可能已经被淘汰。

每轮恰好淘汰一名选手，该选手按如下方式确定：

- 若剩余选手中实力值最小的选手未受保护，则淘汰该选手；
- 否则，淘汰剩余选手中实力值第二小的选手。

被淘汰的选手不再参加游戏。最后一轮结束后，恰好剩下一名选手。

给定序列 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{n-1}$，但实力分布未知。对于每名选手 $j$ 和每一轮 $i$，求使得选手 $j$ 在第 $i$ 轮被淘汰的排列 $(s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n)$ 的数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 2500$）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例由两行组成：

- 第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \le n \le 5000$）——选手的数量；
- 第二行包含 $n-1$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_{n-1}$（$1 \le a_i \le n$）——各轮中受保护的选手编号。$a_i$ 的值可以重复。

输入的附加约束：

- 所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $5000$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，按如下方式输出答案：

设 $ans(i, j)$ 表示使得选手 $i$ 在第 $j$ 轮被淘汰的排列 $(s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n)$ 的数量，并对 $998244353$ 取模。输出一个整数，等于 $\bigoplus_{i=1}^{n} \bigoplus_{j=1}^{n-1} (ans(i,j) \cdot i \cdot j)$，其中 $\oplus$ 表示按位异或（XOR）运算。只有 $ans(i,j)$ 的值对 $998244353$ 取模；乘积 $ans(i,j) \cdot i \cdot j$ 和最终答案均不取模。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，有两种可能的实力分布：$(1,2)$ 和 $(2,1)$。在唯一的一轮中，选手 $2$ 受到保护，因此两种情况下选手 $1$ 都被淘汰。于是 $ans(1,1)=2$，$ans(2,1)=0$，答案为

$$(2 \cdot 1 \cdot 1) \oplus (0 \cdot 2 \cdot 1) = 2.$$

在第二个测试用例中，有 $6$ 种可能的实力分布。$ans(i,j)$ 的值如下表所示：行对应选手，列对应轮次。

|  | $j=1$ | $j=2$ |
|---|---|---|
| $i=1$ | $0$ | $5$ |
| $i=2$ | $3$ | $0$ |
| $i=3$ | $3$ | $1$ |

第一轮中选手 $1$ 受到保护，第二轮中选手 $2$ 受到保护，因此对应的值为零。第二轮中，有五种实力分布会使选手 $1$ 被淘汰，而选手 $3$ 仅在分布 $(3,1,2)$ 下被淘汰。将表中的值乘以对应的选手编号与轮次编号后，我们得到答案

$$0 \oplus 10 \oplus 6 \oplus 0 \oplus 9 \oplus 6 = 3.$$

在第三个测试用例中，有 $24$ 种可能的实力分布。选手 $1$ 在所有轮次中均受到保护，因此从未被淘汰。其余三名选手彼此对称，因此每名选手在每一轮中都会在 $24/3=8$ 种实力分布下被淘汰。$ans(i,j)$ 的值如下表所示：

|  | $j=1$ | $j=2$ | $j=3$ |
|---|---|---|---|
| $i=1$ | $0$ | $0$ | $0$ |
| $i=2$ | $8$ | $8$ | $8$ |
| $i=3$ | $8$ | $8$ | $8$ |
| $i=4$ | $8$ | $8$ | $8$ |

选手 $1$ 对应的乘积均为零。其余选手对应乘积的异或即为答案

$$16 \oplus 32 \oplus 48 \oplus 24 \oplus 48 \oplus 72 \oplus 32 \oplus 64 \oplus 96 = 96.$$
